title: Selection of the substate after power on

entities.name: PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Initial substate entered when UE is powered on with valid USIM available.

entities.name: NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate entered when no cell can be selected, no cell of selected PLMN found in manual mode, or selected cell is non-3GPP.

entities.name: NO-IMSI
entities.description: Substate entered when no USIM is present in the UE.

entities.name: NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when suitable cell found and PLMN/tracking area not in forbidden list.

entities.name: LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when selected cell is known not to provide normal service.

entities.name: eCALL-INACTIVE
entities.description: Substate entered when UE is configured for eCall only mode.

entities.name: USIM available and valid
entities.description: Condition that USIM is present and valid in the UE at power on.

entities.name: UE configured for eCall only mode
entities.description: Condition that UE is configured for emergency call only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

entities.name: T3444
entities.description: Timer considered expired at power on for UE configured for eCall only mode.

entities.name: T3445
entities.description: Timer considered expired at power on for UE configured for eCall only mode.

relations.description: UE enters PLMN-SEARCH substate when USIM is available and valid at power on.
UE enters eCALL-INACTIVE substate when configured for eCall only mode.
Timer T3444 is considered expired at power on for eCall only mode UE.
Timer T3445 is considered expired at power on for eCall only mode UE.
